description: Presidential Secretariat - Call Out with Effect from May 22, 2024 All the Members of the Armed Forces for the Maintenance of Public Order
reasoning: This gazette content involves the President exercising powers under the Public Security Ordinance to call out armed forces for maintaining public order. This constitutes a legal/regulatory matter as it involves the implementation of existing legislation (Public Security Ordinance, Chapter 40) and the issuance of a statutory order with legal force, rather than being primarily about government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
